cases.name: Debra Elizabeth Espey
cases.narrative: On 4/17/1973, her body was discovered off of Rock Bayou Road, by a subject from the U.S Air Force Base who was riding an off road motorcycle. She was nude from the waist down and her murder appeared to be sexually motivated. Ms. Espey’s body was located buried in a shallow grave. The grave site was located just north of State Road 20 (now John Sims Parkway), and east of Rocky Bayou Drive. The area, at the time of Ms. Espey’s death, was a wooded, none residential area.
